summary: Reviewed full template campaign and fixtures, docs and outer Makefile checks. Both exact ordinary/linked runtimes customize fresh project clones and run two real local Git releases through native CLI doubles. First build/repair uses Terra High, critic uses Astra Medium; second task uses Astra Medium. Budgeted build resume retains run and workspace, critic C1 reaches repair, both annotated tags have remote readback/ancestry, repeated completion does not dispatch or republish. A real unmerged index is preserved when integration is refused; missing destination is rejected. Primary project controller requirement is explicit and an unregistered linked controller is refused; owned linked task worktrees read canonical state. Eighteen released-stack regressions cover lost push/GitHub acknowledgement, migration rollback/resume, frozen/unavailable models, unknown/conflicting remotes and cleanup preservation/retry. Live v0.3.26 sample is separately attributed and all 53 runtime hashes match; no hosted deployment/model identity is inferred. A runtime path with spaces exposed the Makefile quoting defect; red/green probe and committed final macOS/Linux gates prove its repair. No changed product content was edited during final verification.
